annotations.title: AI tool router (pick the right tool + arguments)

description: AI tool router (pick the right tool + arguments) — Agent tool routing: give a user request and your tool list, get back the single best tool, filled-in arguments, confidence, missing required parameters, a clarifying question when needed, alternatives, and an offline keyword ranking (BM25-style) as a cross-check. tools= accepts 'name: description; name2: description2' or a JSON array of {name,description} or OpenAI tool objects (parameters.required is checked). Up to 40 tools. Unknown tool names from the model are rejected and fall back to the keyword match. Workers AI. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).

query.description: e.g. what will the weather be in Denver tomorrow

tools.description: e.g. get_weather: forecast for a city; search_flights: find flights between two airports; get_stock: latest stock price

name: ai_tool_select
